name: healthy
description: A well-formed board. The coach should recognise strengths and avoid inventing problems.
expectations: Includes at least two genuine strengths (boardStrengths or nudges with antiPattern 'strength')
Does not flag outcome-1 or outcome-2 as unmeasured or as outputs
Does not claim goal-1 lacks a baseline or target (it has both)
Any issue raised is grounded in the board text (for example that item-4 'Build referral landing page' is in 'ready' with no discovery item under outcome-2 is acceptable to raise)

goals.statement: Increase 30-day retention of new subscribers from 42% to 55% by end of Q2 2027

outcomes.statement: New subscribers plan a full week of meals in their first session
outcomes.behaviorChange: Instead of adding one or two recipes and leaving, new users complete a 7-day plan
outcomes.measureOfSuccess: Share of new subscribers with a 7-day plan after session 1 rises from 18% to 40%

outcomes.statement: Subscribers invite a household member within the first month
outcomes.behaviorChange: Households plan together instead of one person doing it alone
outcomes.measureOfSuccess: Share of subscribers with a second household member after 30 days rises from 9% to 25%

items.title: Interview 8 users who abandoned onboarding
items.description: Understand why users stop after adding 1-2 recipes

items.title: Survey: who else cooks in your household?
